heroDescription: Explore {count} components and layouts. Tweak options, test interactions live, and copy ready-to-run Go code.
installNote: Requires Go 1.27.3+. Set CGO_ENABLED=0 to run desktop apps.
featuresDescription: Every component page runs real Go code, keeping the preview and source in sync.
featureNativeText: Buttons, forms, tables, trees, charts, and layouts for MyGo desktop apps—no Vue, Node.js, or WebView required.
featurePreviewText: Runs real Go component code in your browser via WebAssembly. Fonts and system input may differ from desktop.
featureFieldsText: Tweak common settings quickly, or expand All fields to configure any Options field, nested value, or callback.
featureCodeText: Both the component snippet and complete program stay synced with the preview, ready to paste into main.go.
copyFailed: Couldn't access clipboard. Select the code to copy manually.
codeHint: Save the complete program as main.go in a Go module with this dependency installed, then run with CGO_ENABLED=0. Paste the component snippet into an existing view.
defaultCode: Copying is disabled while the preview updates. Showing the last synced code (or the default example on first load).
platformNote: Previews run Go components in the browser. Fonts and system input may differ from desktop, and native file dialogs or full screen-reader support aren't available here.
footer: Built with MyGo · Nuxt UI style · MIT
parameterHint: Adjust common options below, expand All fields for everything else, or click Reset to start over.
apiHint: Go zero values show what an omitted field holds—the component's actual default is noted in each description. An unset Optional uses the default behavior, while false and 0 can be set explicitly.
